description: Stock Strata v0.2.9 with stock OMP 18.15.0; qwen3.8-flash-next-unsloth-ud-iq4_xs on NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition, native Windows, text only, 262,144-token context. Stock setup-derived thresholds and flags; no hardware qualification or inherited receipts. Stock setup recommendations pinned: --parallel 4, --prefill auto:32768. Stock PLE direct reads pinned: --ple-io direct (the PLE table stays on direct SSD reads instead of the engine's automatic RAM residency). Stock per-slot MTP pinned: --batch-mtp (each batch slot verifies one MTP proposal per window; stock's app turns it on for one card of 24 GB or more with 2+ slots). Stock engine 0.1.55 defaults: int8 prompt attention on these CUDA cards; tool-call recovery for declared tools is on by default (no tool_call_recovery key is written or pinned), alongside always-on quoted-call, missing-function-closer, lenient non-string JSON argument and stray-think-closer repairs; calls inside fenced or indented code stay text (Strata#4702, #4703) and tools the conversation already called count as declared (Strata#4663). The automatic expert cache keeps about 256 MiB more VRAM free (Strata#4474). With pinned batch slots, conversation parking keeps the shared prefix (Strata#4420). The pinned --ple-io direct reads replace automatic RAM PLE residency; the residency policy and its Strata#4518 lock release do not apply. Stock's Linux-only parallel-slot and GDN tensor-core prompt defaults do not apply on Windows. These SM120 cards use the wide-up and stream-split hyper-connection reads, now with exact 5-8 token decode kernels; single-card layer-major prefill stays off. Stock OMP 18.15.0 selects replace editing for Qwen3.8; no edit-mode override is pinned. Hybrid CPU, 8 performance + 16 efficiency cores: stock --pool-workers 15.
